identity: Server-verified session only; never accept household or author identity from request body

routes.purpose: List observations for the authorised child
Create observation for the authorised child

tables.name: eyfs_observations
rules: foreign key child_id to child profiles
household_id must match child's current household
all operations filtered by authenticated parent ownership
no ELG mastery flag inferred from observations

apiRequirements: CSRF protection where cookie authentication is used
Server-side validation of activity IDs and notes
No cross-tenant identifiers in error details
Transactional access checks on write and delete
Export and deletion rights with retention policy
No public sharing or media attachments
implementationGates: Confirm existing authentication provider and child-profile schema
Implement and test database row-level security
Review UK GDPR lawful basis and retention notice
Verify production secrets and migration rollback plan
